google.label: Worldwide Google Trends relative search-interest index
google.method_note: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude were retrieved in one joint comparison and aggregated from weekly values to calendar-month means. Values are normalized indices, not search counts or market shares.

github.broad_declared_label: New public, non-fork repositories matching the exact phrase “AI agent” in GitHub repository search
github.topic_label: New repositories carrying GitHub’s artificial-intelligence topic at retrieval
github.signed_commit_label: Signed public default-branch coding-agent commits detected by the independent powerset tracker
github.method_note: The three GitHub series are intentionally not combined. The broad self-description series is not a code-authorship measure; the topic series is retrospective; the signed-commit series misses unsigned and private activity. March 2025 has partial tracker coverage and is excluded from the agent-by-agent map.

yc.method_note: The AI directory tag is treated as a discovery label, not a ground-truth time series. A direct manual review read the public YC one-liner and description for a frozen sample.
yc.non_tagged_note: This deliberately semantic sample demonstrates clear false negatives; it is not a statistical recall estimate.
